opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The order granting an interlocutory injuction is affirmed. Alabama v. United States, 279 U. S. 229; United Fuel Gas Co. v. Public Service Commission, 278 U. S. 322, 326; National Fire Ins. Co. v. Thompson, 281 U. S. 331, 338.
